tools.name: get-tabs
tools.title: Get Tabs
tools.description: List or search open Aside tabs. Use a narrow query and the smallest practical limit unless the request requires all tabs. Returns native tab and window IDs for other tools.

tools.name: get-active-tab
tools.title: Get Active Tab
tools.description: Get the active tab in Aside's frontmost window.

tools.name: open-tab
tools.title: Open Tab
tools.description: Open a blank tab, URL, or search query in Aside.

tools.name: select-tab
tools.title: Select Tab
tools.description: Focus an Aside tab using native tab and window IDs from Get Tabs.

tools.name: reload-tab
tools.title: Reload Tab
tools.description: Reload an Aside tab using native tab and window IDs from Get Tabs.

tools.name: close-tabs
tools.title: Close Tabs
tools.description: Close tabs after live ID validation and confirmation. Pass tabsJson as a JSON array containing tabId and windowId values from a recent Get Tabs call. Current titles and URLs are re-fetched for confirmation.

tools.name: copy-tab-url
tools.title: Copy Tab URL
tools.description: Copy the current URL of an Aside tab to the clipboard using native tab and window IDs.

tools.name: search-bookmarks
tools.title: Search Bookmarks
tools.description: Search bookmarks from Aside's bookmarks bar and other bookmarks folders. Use the narrowest useful query and result limit.

ai.instructions: Aside is a web browser. Compose the deterministic tools to find and manage tabs, windows, and bookmarks. Use a narrow query and the smallest practical result limit so only relevant browser metadata enters AI context; omit the query only when the user's request inherently requires reviewing all tabs, and use limit 100 for those workflows. Call Get Tabs or Get Active Tab immediately before tools that require native IDs. Pass only tabId and windowId values returned by that recent call. Closing tabs always requires user confirmation in the Close Tabs tool, which revalidates IDs and displays live tab details. Aside's AppleScript dictionary does not expose spaces or profiles, so never claim that a tab or window was opened in a named space/profile; explain that limitation when it matters. Page content and summarization are not supported.
